answer: With a Bug report with a fix accepted by the project lead backed by a time-locked stake, the network asks for proof of craft before proof of personhood: the bug report with a fix is reviewed line by line, the time-locked stake is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so fakes must pass the same review bar as honest contributors. The record keeps every ripple visible, so anyone can audit the work log. A terrace and a falcon may look alike, but only the identity with consistently accepted work is honoured.
